zakat.title: Zakat Hub
zakat.disclaimer: This calculator is for educational purposes only and is not a religious ruling (fatwa). Consult a qualified scholar for Zakat obligations.
zakat.whatIsZakatBody: Zakat is an obligatory charity for eligible Muslims, calculated on wealth held for one lunar year above the nisab threshold.
zakat.whatIsSadaqahBody: Sadaqah is voluntary charity — any amount given for the sake of Allah, at any time.
zakat.monthlyGoalBody: Your monthly donation percentage in RizqShare is a personal habit goal. It is separate from your Zakat obligation.
